correctness.rationale: Normalizing δ_k(z)=Σ_{j=1}^k(1-z)^j/j gives p4 and p5 exact rational polynomials and [z²]p4^α=α(1152α-252)/625, [z²]p5^α=300α(150α-13)/18769. BDF6 has [z²]p6^α=α(150+7200α)/2401>0. At each threshold, the derivative recurrence nW_n=Σ_{j=1}^{min(k,n)}(((1+α)j-n)p_j W_{n-j}) gives rational signs W1<0, W2=0, W3..W999<0 (independently recomputed exactly). Schur reductions certify all zeros of q4 lie outside 7/5, q5 outside 4/3, which allows Cauchy eta-coefficient bounds; the explicit half-tail bounds for n>=1000 have C1/1000=.34125 or .3912, plus <.01 remainder, below q(1)^α. Thus W_n<0 for all n>=1000 analytically, not by finite exhaustion. Positive-series fractional composition transfers strict negativity for smaller α. Independent numeric root moduli and rational tail-bound checks corroborated.
